name: next-steps-app
description: After each turn, suggests up to three next prompts above the input, in the terminal and the desktop app. Number and text are colored apart; press 1-3 or click to draft, 0 to dismiss.

author.name: Based on next-steps by Thariq Shihipar

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to suggest after
minAnswerChars.description: Skip suggestions after answers shorter than this many characters.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Tell the suggester which skills and slash commands this session has.

blankBetween.title: Blank line between suggestions
blankBetween.description: Leave an empty line between suggestions and the dismiss row.
